# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Compiler XML documentation**

## Highlights

Upcoming builds package compiler-generated XML documentation alongside SkiaSharp assemblies. API documentation now originates from C# XML comments and is shipped with the managed packages, improving the documentation available to consumers and tooling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation sidecars** — Managed packages include compiler-generated XML documentation so IDEs and documentation tooling can consume the public API descriptions directly. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080))
